feedback: The GROUP BY clause in the MostCommonPaymentTypePerCategory CTE is incorrect. It should include both product_category_name and payment_type to correctly identify the most common payment type per category.

The logic does not correctly identify the top three product categories whose most commonly used payment type has the highest number of payments across all categories. It only finds the most common payment type per category and then limits the result to three categories with the highest payment counts, which may not be the same as the top categories with the highest number of payments for their most common payment type.
